blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multimodal code intelligence connects the symbolic world of programs with the visual world their execution creates. Interest in this capability is burgeoning, as models are increasingly asked to produce charts, webpages, animations, and semi-structured documents. Recently, proprietary models have pushed far ahead, producing interactive artifacts even from a text description or a screenshot alone. Yet their data and training remain closed, and open progress is held back by the quantity and quality of available data and by the pipelines and methods for producing it. Quality is the harder of the two, since a sample must be correct as a program, well built, and above all visually right once rendered. No existing signal covers all three. Execution often returns just a pass or fail, code similarity does not map to the visual output, and task-specific verifiers do not generalize. To push open progress further, we start from the data side with PrismaForge, a hierarchical data pipeline centered on a synthesized rubric that decomposes these factors into checkable criteria. The same rubric serves as both filter and reward: it curates the supervised corpus, then drives reinforcement learning on visual-coding tasks. Leveraging PrismaForge for data synthesis and filtering, we build PrismaCoder-2M, the most diverse open dataset for multimodal code intelligence and the largest to date. On the model side, we train PrismaCoder-9B and PrismaCoder-35B on this data and release both. They lead the open state of the art by a wide margin and rival leading proprietary systems. Our analyses further show that the proposed rubric-based pipeline improves multimodal coding performance across model backbones. We release our code and data at https://qiushisun.github.io/PrismaCoder-Home/.
blocks.zh: 多式联运代码智能将程序的象征世界与它们的执行所创造的视觉世界联系起来. 对这种能力的兴趣正在增长,因为人们越来越多地要求模型制作图表、网页、动画和半结构文件。 最近,专有模型推进了很远的一步,甚至从文本描述或截图中产生交互式文物. 然而,他们的数据和培训仍然关闭,现有数据的数量和质量以及生产数据的管道和方法阻碍了开放的进展。 质量是两者中最难的,因为一个样本必须作为一个程序正确,构建良好,最重要的是,一旦被渲染出来,就具有视觉权利。 没有现有的信号覆盖所有三个. 执行通常只返回一个通过或失败,代码相似性不映射到视觉输出,任务特定核查者不概括. 为了进一步推进开放进展,我们从数据侧面开始与PrismaForge(英语:PrismaForge),一个分级的数据管道,其中心是一个将这些因素分解成可核查标准的合成标题. 同一标题既可以过滤,又可以奖励:它可以校准被监管人,然后推动在视觉编码任务方面的强化学习。 利用普里斯玛 Forge用于数据合成和过滤,我们建造了Prisma Coder-2M,这是用于多式联运代码智能的最多样化开放数据集,也是迄今为止最大的数据集. 在模型方面,我们在此数据上训练Prisma Coder-9B和Prisma Coder-35B,并同时发布两者. 它们以广阔的优势领导着开放的艺术状态,并竞争着领先的专有系统. 我们的分析进一步表明,拟议的基于标题的管道改进了示范骨干之间的多式联运编码工作。 我们在https://qiushisun.github.io/PrismaCoder-Home/上发布了我们的代码和数据。

Recently, open work such as

shared visual-programmatic interface, with follow-up refinements building on the

blocks.en:
To address this gap, we introduce PrismaForge , a rubric-based framework for multimodal code data curation and policy optimization. Rather than relying solely on a holistic judgment or a fixed checklist, PrismaForge applies a common evaluation procedure across data sources and task domains while tailoring its criteria to each instruction. Each rubric combines reusable domain-level checks with instruction-specific requirements, with the number of criteria adjusted to the estimated task difficulty. Code-level and visual-level criteria are evaluated separately on the generated program and its rendered artifact, respectively.
These scores guide data curation and serve as reinforcement learning rewards.
blocks.zh:
为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了PrismaForge,这是一个基于名义的框架,用于多式联运编码数据整理和政策优化。 PrismaForge不单单依靠一个整体判断或一个固定清单,而是在整个数据来源和任务领域适用一个共同的评价程序,同时根据每项指令调整其标准。 每个标题将可重复使用的域级检查与特定指令要求相结合,标准数量根据估计任务难度进行调整. 代码级和可视级标准分别对生成的程序及其出品进行单独评价.
这些分数指导了数据整理,并起到强化学习奖励的作用.

blocks.en:
Using PrismaForge , we curate PrismaCoder -2M, the broadest open dataset to date for advancing multimodal code intelligence, spanning more than 12 categories and
10 programming languages with both text-centric and vision-centric data. To build this coverage, we draw seeds from complementary sources: public visual-coding corpora cover common plotting and graphics tasks; research figures and open-source repositories contribute long-tail scientific examples; and web, interactive-demo, and chemical-structure sources broaden the range of artifacts. We then convert the seeds into self-contained tasks, check candidate programs through format-specific execution and rendering, and use instruction-specific rubric scores to filter or refine the resulting examples. This gives the dataset both breadth of coverage and a consistent quality-control process.

blocks.en:
To assess whether the breadth of PrismaCoder -2M translates into broad model capability, we develop PrismaCoder -9B and PrismaCoder -35B.
Evaluated on a wide range of representative benchmarks, PrismaCoder leads the existing open state of the art by a wide margin and matches the proprietary systems to a considerable degree ( § 5 ).
Through extensive analyses ( § 6 ), we show that the data and pipeline generalize across base models beyond our release. We further show that rubric-guided curation outperforms direct-judge selection and that rubric scores align closely with human judgments.

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en:
Code intelligence now extends beyond text-only programming to visual-programmatic tasks, where intent may be visual ( Li et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024a ; Wang et al., 2025 ) and outputs can be judged only after execution or rendering ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) .
On the output side, syntactic validity is insufficient; correctness also depends on layout, semantics, interaction, and editability.
On the input side, reading values and layout off renders remains a perception bottleneck ( Masry et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Xia et al., 2025 ) across vision-language models ( Zhang et al., 2024b ; Liu et al., 2025 ) .
The tasks run from screenshot-to-code ( Gui et al., 2025 ; Si et al., 2025 ; Yun et al., 2024 ) to front-end engineering ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2025a ) and generative UI ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) ; chart generation ( Yang et al., 2025a ; Zhao et al., 2025c ; Wu et al., 2025 ) and editing ( Zhang et al., 2024c ; Zhao et al., 2025b ) ; SVG and symbolic graphics ( Yang et al., 2025b ; Nishina & Matsui, 2024 ; Xu et al., 2024 ) with their structural probes ( Qiu et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025b ) ; and interactive artifacts and code-driven demonstrations ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Ku et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2025b ) .
Recent generalists unify these domains via JanusCoder’s visual-programmatic interface ( Sun et al., 2026b ) , VisCodex’s vision–code integration ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) , VisCoder2’s agentic visualization coding ( Ni et al., 2026 ) , and VinciCoder’s visual reinforcement learning ( Zhao et al., 2025a ) .
Yet a shared modeling interface does not by itself make heterogeneous notions of correctness consistently measurable or usable for training ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) .
Complementing this progress, we contribute on the data side, with PrismaCoder -2M spanning the broadest scenarios and open data types.

blocks.en:
Conventional code tasks ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) draw training data from instruction synthesis and evolution ( Wei et al., 2024 ; Luo et al., 2024 ; Luo et al., 2025b ) .
For many such tasks, executable tests provide a cheap, reproducible signal for data filtering ( Xu et al., 2025b ; Sun et al., 2026a ) and reinforcement learning ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2025a ; Zhuo et al., 2025 ) .
Visual outputs break this assumption: successful execution confirms only that the code runs, not that its render is faithful, well composed, or semantically correct ( Zhao et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) .
Visual benchmarks instead use task-specific render checks for charts ( Yang et al., 2025a ) , visual and structural similarity for web pages ( Si et al., 2025 ) , or judge protocols for interactive artifacts ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) ; effective individually, these measures do not compose across artifacts.
Recent work moves toward finer supervision, from JanusCoder’s single-pass rubric over fixed dimensions ( Sun et al., 2026b ) to VinciCoder’s coarse-to-fine rewards ( Zhao et al., 2025a ) . Neither signal is yet both fine enough to localize failures and general enough to cover every task, at curation and at training alike. In this work, one synthesized rubric per instruction serves both roles, filtering the training data and rewarding reinforcement learning across every format we cover.

对于许多此类任务,可执行测试为数据过滤(徐等,2025b;孙等,2026a)和强化学习(邵等,2024;徐等,2025a;卓等,2025)提供了廉价可再生信号.
视觉输出打破了这一假设:成功执行仅证实代码运行,而非其渲染是忠实的,构成良好的,或精准正确(赵等,2026;刘等,2026;郭等,2025.).
视觉基准则使用特定任务检查图表(Yang等人,2025年a),网页的视觉和结构相似性(Si等人,2025年),或互动文物的审判规程(Zhang等人,2025年);这些措施个别有效,并不跨越文物。
最近的工作转向了更精细的监督,从Janus Coder的固定维度单行本(Sun等,2026b)到Vinci Coder的粗糙到精细的奖励 (赵等,2025a. 两个信号都不够好,既能确定失败之处,又能概括地涵盖每一项任务,无论是在管理还是培训方面。 在这项工作中,一个综合的每个教学标题既服务于两个角色,又过滤培训数据,并奖励我们涵盖的每一种形式的强化学习。

blocks.en: 3.1. Elastic Rubric Scorer
blocks.zh: 3.1. 弹性鲁布里克分数器

blocks.en: For a large-scale coding dataset prepared for visualization or demonstration, the key challenge is to determine which candidates are sufficiently correct and useful to retain. Unlike problems with easily verifiable outputs, visualization quality is often specified only implicitly ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025a ) . A single holistic score is therefore hard to verify and offers little insight into why a candidate succeeds or fails ( Ye et al., 2024 ; Sun et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh: 对于为可视化或演示而准备的大型编码数据集,关键的挑战在于确定哪些候选人足够正确和有用,可以保留. 与容易可核查的出品的问题不同,可视化质量往往只是隐含地规定(Wu等,2025;Yang等,2025a.). 因此,单一的整体分数难以核实,对候选人成功或失败的原因知之甚少(Ye等,2024;Sun等,2026b.).

blocks.en: A natural alternative is to evaluate candidates using explicit criteria, but a fixed rubric is too coarse for diverse visualization tasks. Different instructions may prioritize numerical accuracy and axis scales, visual similarity, layout, or artifact editability. A universal rubric must stay broad and may miss the properties most important for a specific example. At the other extreme, manually designing separate rubrics for every visualization instruction would require substantial human effort and is hard to scale.
blocks.zh: 一个自然的替代办法是使用明确的标准来评价考生,但固定名词对于多种可视化任务来说过于粗糙. 不同的指令可以优先排列数字精度和轴平面,视觉相似性,布局,或文物可编辑性. 一个通用的标点必须保持宽度,并可能错过对具体例子最重要的属性. 在另一个极端,为每个可视化教学手动设计单独的标题,需要大量人力,而且很难扩大规模。

blocks.en: To balance these two extremes, we introduce a sample-specific rubric system that combines reusable domain-level criteria with criteria synthesized specifically for each instruction.
blocks.zh: 为了平衡这两个极端,我们引入了一个样本特定的标题系统,将可重复使用的域级标准与专门为每个指令所合成的标准结合起来.

blocks.en:
Because multimodal code artifacts are ultimately created for humans, consistency with human judgment provides a compelling test to verify that the quality of data yielded by our rubric-based PrismaForge aligns more closely with human preferences.
At the same time, preserving the relative ordering induced by scores is particularly important for reward-based policy optimization, where inconsistent rankings can provide conflicting training signals.
To evaluate our method along both dimensions, we conducted a human study. We sampled 100 examples from our training data and asked human annotators, as well as three proprietary model judges, to evaluate them using direct scoring and the PrismaForge rubrics, respectively. We then measured the agreement between each model judge and the human ratings in terms of both absolute score levels and pairwise ordering ( Fig. 7 ). The rubric-based judging method achieves substantially higher agreement with human judgments and greater consistency in the induced partial ordering across all three model judges. The full study protocol and detailed statistics are provided in Appendix § H.2 .
We further show that the gains of our pipeline hold across judge models, with the
experiments presented in Appendix § H.1 .

blocks.en: 7. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7. 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we push open multimodal code intelligence forward by jointly
contributing and fully releasing data, pipeline, and models. PrismaForge treats
multimodal code data under one lens with rubrics synthesized from coarse to fine
and decomposed into code-level and visual-level criteria, a signal that both
generalizes and localizes what went wrong.
We then curate and release PrismaCoder -2M, the most broadly covering open dataset
for multimodal code intelligence, which enables principled selection and stable reinforcement learning on
visual-coding tasks. On this data we build PrismaCoder -9B/35B, which lead the open state of the art
by a wide margin and rival proprietary systems. Extensive analyses across base models and task recipes show that the data and
the pipeline generalize beyond our release, and we share these insights and resources
to broaden access to visual-coding capabilities.

blocks.en: A.1. AST-Based Decomposition
blocks.zh: A.1. 基于AST的分解

blocks.en:
Plotting scripts collected from GitHub and Manim scene files are often long, and one file may
draw several figures.
For such data, we parse each script into an abstract syntax tree without executing it and split it into self-contained units. A unit is the code that produces one figure in a plotting script, or one scene in a Manim file (a class inheriting from Scene ). Each unit keeps the imports and statements it depends on,
drops project-private helpers that exist only in the source repository, and carries its embedded
text and a short excerpt as features. The units are stored as structured entries that the
synthesis pipeline and the gatekeeper of Section § 4.2 read. All of these processing pipelines will be made public.

blocks.en:
Web UI reconstruction must be evaluated from two complementary perspectives: whether the generated HTML/CSS implements the required content and structure, and whether its rendered output reproduces the intended visual appearance.
A single holistic score often conflates these two aspects and provides little evidence about the source of an error.
We therefore synthesize two sets of sample-specific binary rubrics from the task instruction and reference screenshot.
Code rubrics target properties that can be verified directly from the implementation, whereas vision rubrics target properties observable in the rendered page. Figs. 8 and 9 show the corresponding prompt templates.
Both prompts organize checks into shared quality criteria and sample-dependent requirements, and assign each check a weight according to its importance.
The difficulty level assigned to the instruction enters both prompts as an item budget, so harder samples receive more criteria ( § 3.1 ).
The templates are abridged to remove repetitive wording.

Web UI 重建必须从两个互补的角度来评价:生成的HTML/CSS是否执行需要的内容和结构,以及其提供的输出是否复制了预期的视觉外观.
单一的整体分数往往将这两个方面混为一谈,对出错的来源没有提供多少证据.
因此,我们从任务指示和参考截图中综合了两套特定样本的二进制数字。

blocks.en: In our experiments, we use Gemini-3-Flash for rubrics. For common visualization tasks, such as Python plotting, the average cost of generating rubrics for a single sample is approximately $0.006 based on the official API pricing, while evaluating the generated code and visual artifacts costs approximately $0.01 per sample. blocks.en: This appendix specifies the reward computation procedure behind § 3.2 .
blocks.zh: 本附录具体说明了第3.2节背后的奖励计算程序。

blocks.en: For each rollout response c i ( k ) c_{i}^{(k)} , the procedure first extracts code from the response text. For Python, we extract the longest fenced code block. For HTML, we extract a single complete document spanning from the doctype declaration to the closing tag. For SVG, we extract either the code contained in a fenced block or the first complete <svg> span. A completion that does not contain valid code of the required type is assigned a reward of 0 0 without further evaluation.
blocks.zh: 对于每个推出响应c i (k) c_{i}^{ (k)},程序首先从响应文本中提取代码. 对于Python,我们提取出最长的栅栏码块. 对于HTML,我们提取一个从doctype声明到关闭标记的完整文档. 对于SVG,我们提取栅栏区块中包含的代码或者第一个完整的"svg"跨度. 未包含所要求类型有效代码的完成,在不作进一步评价的情况下,指定0分的奖励.

blocks.en: A dispatcher then routes each rollout to exactly one task family, and the scorer registered for that family returns a reward in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , where 1 1 denotes a fully satisfactory solution. An unscoreable completion (due to a missing or malformed answer, unavailable rubric or reference material, execution or rendering failure, or a judge failure that persists after retries) receives a reward of 0 0 .
blocks.zh: 然后,调度员将每次推出都引导到一个完全的任务家庭,登记该家庭的计分员在[0, 1] [0, 1] 中返回奖励,其中1 1 表示完全满意的解决办法. 无法记分的完成(由于答案缺失或不正确、没有标题或参考材料、执行或造成失败,或法官在复试后持续存在的失败)得到0分的奖励。

blocks.en: The basic reward computation for each task largely follows Eq. 2 and Eq. 3 . Specifically, the response code and the rendered visual artifact are scored separately and then aggregated using a weighted average. We use different combinations of code-score and visual-score weights across task families. This is because for tasks such as Python plotting, correct data representation and placement are as important as visual integrity and presentation quality. In contrast, for educational demonstration artifacts, visual readiness and interactivity are often more important than the particular implementation used to produce them.
blocks.zh: 每项任务的基本奖励计算主要遵循Eq. 2和Eq. 3。 具体来说,反应码和制成的视觉文物是分别打分的,然后使用加权平均值进行汇总. 我们使用不同的组合 代码分数和视觉分数 重在任务家庭。 这是因为对于Python绘图等任务来说,正确的数据表示和放置与视觉完整性和呈现质量同样重要. 相比之下,对于教育示范文物而言,视觉准备和互动往往比用来生产这些文物的具体实施更为重要。

blocks.en: We found, however, that predefined rubrics alone may fail to capture certain forms of misalignment in a few tasks such as interface reproduction. Instructions for these tasks inherently allow some flexibility in content generation, particularly with respect to styling and layout organization. As a result, some errors or mismatches can only be assessed reliably after the generated page is viewed alongside the reference page. To address this limitation, we introduce a complementary holistic score for task families of this type. This score is combined with the rubric-based scores using a weight denoted by λ h \lambda_{h} . In this way, the evaluation retains the consistency and structure of rubric-based scoring while also capturing qualitative discrepancies that become apparent only when the generated artifact is evaluated as a whole.
blocks.zh: 然而,我们发现,仅在预定义的标点可能无法在界面复制等少数任务中捕捉某些形式的错配. 对这些任务的指示在内容生成方面,特别是在格式和布局安排方面,具有一定的灵活性。 因此,只有在生成的页面与参考页面一并查看后,才能可靠地评估出一些错误或错配. 为了消除这一局限性,我们为这类任务家庭引入了一个补充性的整体分数。 此分数与基于分数的分数结合,使用以QQ h\lambda_{h}表示的分数. 这样,评价保留了基于分数的一致性和结构,同时也记录了只有在对生成的文物进行整体评价时才显现的质量差异。

blocks.en: For each sample, the rubric-based method requires one API call to score each modality. Because code and visual artifacts are evaluated separately, its API cost is approximately 2 × 2\times that of directly scoring the visual outputs alone. In our experiments, a full round of GRPO training involves approximately 808K judgment requests. Resource constraints prevented a full GRPO comparison between PrismaForge and direct scoring. In a focused Python plotting experiment, rubric-based scoring improved ChartMimic overall by 6.91 points over direct scoring.

blocks.en: All experiments were conducted on four interconnected compute nodes, each equipped with 8 NVIDIA H200 GPUs, for a total of 32 GPUs. We used the Megatron backend in the ms-swift framework for distributed SFT and RL. Both stages performed full-parameter fine-tuning with FlashAttention and sequence parallelism enabled. Activation recomputation reduced memory use throughout training.
blocks.zh: 所有实验都是在四个互相连接的计算节点上进行的,每个节点都配备了8个NVIDIA H200 GPU,总共32个GPU. 我们用Ms-swift框架中的威震天后端来分配SFT和RL. 这两个阶段都进行了全参数的微调,FlashAttention和相序平行性被启用。 激活重算减少了整个训练过程中的内存使用.

blocks.en: For SFT, we initialized from Qwen3.5-9B/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B and trained the language model for 5 epochs. We used a maximum sequence length of 32,768 tokens and enabled sequence packing for improved token utilization. The global batch size was set to be 128. The learning rate peaked at 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} , with a warm-up fraction of 5%, and decayed to a minimum learning rate of 5 × 10 − 7 5\times 10^{-7} .
blocks.zh: 对于SFT,我们从Quen3.5-9B/Quen3.5-35B-A3B初始化,并训练了5个纪元的语言模型. 我们使用了最大序列长度为32,768个令牌,并启用了序列包装,以改善令牌使用. 全球批量规模被设定为128个. 学习率以1×10-5 1\times 10×5}达到顶峰,取暖分数为5%,衰落到最低学习率为5×10−7 5\times 10×7}.

blocks.en: For RL, we initialized from the SFT checkpoint and performed one epoch of GRPO/GSPO. We implemented a rubric-based reward plugin following the methodology described in Section 3.2 and Appendix D . For the judge model L J L^{J} used to evaluate online rollouts, we selected Gemini-3-Flash to balance evaluation quality and cost. The global training batch size was 512 in terms of rollouts (equivalent to 64 samples per batch) and 8 candidate responses were generated per prompt at each rollout step. Rollout generation was performed with colocated vLLM inference using tensor parallelism of size 8 and a maximum model length of 36,000 tokens. Sampling used a temperature of 1.0 and top- p p of 0.95.
blocks.zh: 就RL而言,我们从SFT检查站初始化,并完成了一个世纪的GPRO/GSPO. 我们采用第3.2节和附录D所述方法,实施了基于标题的奖励插件。 我们选择双子座-3-Flash来平衡评价的质量和成本。 全球培训批量规模在推出方面为512个(相当于每批64个样本),在每个推出步骤上每快生成8个候选答复。 推出生成时采用同地置放的vLLM推论,采用尺寸为8的拉伸平行式,最大模型长度为36,000个令牌. 采样使用温度为1.0,顶端-p为0.95.

We used a KL regularization coefficient of β = 0.04 \beta=0.04 , and asymmetric clipping thresholds of ϵ = 0.20 \epsilon=0.20 and ϵ high = 0.28 \epsilon_{\mathrm{high}}=0.28 . Dynamic sampling and overlong-response filtering were enabled during rollout collection. blocks.en: The complete results of the direct-1800 split of the ChartMimic benchmark is shown in Table 8 . We can see that PrismaCoder shows strong performance against both open and proprietary models. blocks.en: Table 9 illustrates a more detailed results of PandasPlotBench. On this benchmark, PrismaCoder demonstrates competitive visualization-code generation performance across both model scales. blocks.en:
Table 14 shows that PrismaCoder ’s advantage is consistent across webpages of different code lengths. PrismaCoder -9B obtains Visual scores of 90.06, 90.02, and 91.15 on the short, mid, and long subsets, respectively, while its LLM score remains similarly stable across the three groups.
CLIP similarity decreases modestly with page length, from 90.29 to 87.32, but remains well above the prior open models throughout.
The main exception is TreeBLEU: both PrismaCoder models score below JanusCoder and VinciCoder despite producing substantially more faithful renderings according to the visual metrics.
This difference arises because TreeBLEU measures similarity to the reference HTML tree rather than the rendered webpage itself.
JanusCoder and VinciCoder are trained on the original WebCode2M code, which naturally favors reproducing structures similar to the benchmark references. PrismaCoder instead uses regenerated code paired with webpages rendered from that code, rather than directly using the original WebCode2M source code.
This regeneration is intentional.
The original WebCode2M code comes from diverse real-world webpages and can differ substantially from the code distribution naturally produced by LLMs.
Using regenerated code therefore better aligns the training targets with inference-time generations, while re-rendering the regenerated programs ensures exact consistency between the code and its visual target.
Its generated webpages can consequently closely match the target appearance without following the particular HTML or DOM structure of the reference implementation.
The similarly low TreeBLEU scores of the proprietary models further illustrate that reference-code similarity does not necessarily track rendering fidelity.
blocks.zh:
表14显示,Prisma Coder的优势在不同代码长度的网页上是一致的。 Prisma 编码器 -9B 获得 视觉分数分别为90.06分,90.02分和91.15分,分别位于短分,中分和长分,而其LLM分数在三组之间同样保持稳定.
CLIP相似性随着页面长度从90.29到87.32略有下降,但在整个过程中仍然远远高于以前的开放模型.
主要的例外是 TreeBLEU: 两个Prisma 编码器模型的得分低于Janus Coder和Vinci Coder,尽管根据可视度表,可以产生相当多忠实的渲染.
之所以出现这种差异,是因为TreadyBLEU测量与参考HTML树的相似性,而不是所渲染的网页本身.
Janus Coder和VinciCoder在最初的WebCode2M代码上接受了训练,这自然有利于复制类似于基准引用的结构. 普里斯玛 代碼取而代之的是使用由该代码所提供网页再生成的编码配对,而不是直接使用原WebCode2M源代码.
这种再生是故意的。
最初的WebCode2M代码出自多种现实世界的网页,可以与LLMs自然产生的代码分布有很大的不同.
因此,使用再生成代码可以更好地使训练目标与推断时代相协调,而再生成程序则确保了代码与其视觉目标之间的准确一致性.
它所生成的网页因此可以紧密地匹配目标外观,而不必遵循参考执行的特定HTML或DOM结构.
类似低的TreeBLEU的专有型号的分数进一步说明,参考码的相似性并不一定跟踪渲染的忠诚度.

blocks.en:
The detailed results in Table 15 show that the generation gains are consistent across multiple visual metrics. PrismaCoder -9B reaches a Judge score of 69.95 and a CLIP score of 84.77, while reducing MAE to 42.07 and increasing SSIM to 0.6956. PrismaCoder -35B exhibits a nearly identical profile and achieves the lowest MAE and highest SSIM among the evaluated models.
The agreement across Judge, CLIP, MAE, and SSIM indicates that the improvement is not tied to a particular evaluator, but is consistently reflected across multiple complementary measures of visual similarity.
Editing shows a more nuanced pattern: both PrismaCoder models achieve an Editing-Judge score of about 8.9, substantially exceeding the prior open baselines and matching GPT-4o, while remaining slightly behind Gemini 3.1 Pro.
In contrast, their CMS and image-based similarity metrics are less competitive with the strongest proprietary models.
This difference can be partly attributed to the reference-dependent nature of these metrics.
CMS measures the overlap between the code lines modified by the model and those modified in the reference implementation, so a correct edit may still receive a lower score when it is realized through different code locations.
Similarly, MAE and SSIM compare the resulting rendering against a specific reference output and can penalize visually different but still valid implementations.
The strong Editing-Judge scores therefore suggest that PrismaCoder reliably completes the requested modifications, even when its implementation and rendering differ from the reference.

因此,强大的编辑-法官评分表明,Prisma Coder可靠地完成了所要求的修改,即使其执行和渲染与参考不同。

Table 16 provides a finer-grained view of the visual gains on Design2Code. PrismaCoder -9B reaches 90.09 in Block, 95.95 in Text, 89.30 in Position, 90.00 in Color, and 92.37 in CLIP, yielding an average Visual score of 91.54.
Relative to VinciCoder-8B, the largest gains appear in Position, Color, and Block, which improve by 15.40, 13.00, and 10.68 points, respectively, whereas the improvements in Text and CLIP are smaller.
Under the Design2Code evaluation, these dimensions respectively capture spatial alignment of matched elements, perceptual color fidelity, and the coverage of visual blocks while penalizing missing or hallucinated elements.
The results therefore indicate that PrismaCoder ’s advantage comes primarily from recovering a more complete set of webpage elements and placing them more accurately, together with improved color matching, rather than simply reproducing the visible text. PrismaCoder -35B exhibits a very similar metric profile, with only minor differences between the two model sizes across the evaluated dimensions.

blocks.en: Table 17 presents the overall and domain-level performance on ArtifactsBench. The results show that our models generalize well across the heterogeneous artifact types in ArtifactsBench. Rather than being concentrated in a single domain, PrismaCoder -9B maintains strong performance across all five categories and achieves the highest overall score among the open models, with particularly strong results on SVG generation and web applications. PrismaCoder -35B reaches a similar overall level but shows a different strength profile, with especially strong performance on game development and simulation. This contrast suggests that the two models are capable of handling different forms of front-end complexity, from visual and interface construction to artifacts that require richer interaction and application logic. More importantly, both models consistently outperform the other open baselines and the proprietary baseline at the overall level, despite ArtifactsBench spanning substantially different artifact structures. This cross-domain consistency indicates that their advantage is not tied to a specific artifact format, but reflects stronger general front-end code generation and the ability to turn complex specifications into executable artifacts.
blocks.zh: 表17列示了Artifacts Bench的整体和域级性能. 结果显示,我们的模型在Artifacts Bench 中很好地概括了各种各样的文物类型。 Prisma Coder -9B不是集中在一个单一领域,而是在所有五个类别中保持了强劲的性能,并在开放型号中取得了最高的整体分数,在SVG生成和网络应用上取得了特别强的成果. Prisma 编码器 -35B达到类似的整体水平,但表现出不同的强度剖面,在游戏开发与模拟方面表现特别强. 这种对比表明,两种模型能够处理不同形式的前端复杂性,从视觉和界面构造到需要更丰富的交互和应用逻辑的文物. 更重要的是,尽管Artifacts Bench的工艺结构大相径庭,但两种模型在总体水平上始终比其他开放基线和专利基线要好。 这种跨域一致性表明,它们的优势并不与特定的文物格式相接,而是反映了更强大的一般前端代码生成以及将复杂的规格转化为可执行文物的能力.

blocks.en: Table 18 shows full metrics on InteractScience for both PFT and VQT lenses. The results highlight the complementary strengths of our models captured by the two lenses of InteractScience. PFT measures whether a model can correctly implement the interactive components specified in a long implementation plan, while VQT places greater emphasis on integrating visual understanding, executable code, and scientific reasoning. Our models perform particularly strongly under this setting. PrismaCoder -9B and PrismaCoder -35B both achieve substantially higher VQT scores than the other open models, while also maintaining competitive PFT performance. This gap is important because success on VQT cannot be obtained simply by producing syntactically valid front-end code. The generated science demos must also reflect the intended visual state and the scientific relationships encoded in the task. The results therefore point to a useful property of our models whose capability is not limited to implementing isolated UI interactions, but extends to coordinating code, visual requirements, and scientific content when following a detailed implementation plan.
blocks.zh: 表18显示了PFT和VQT镜头的交互式科学全方位计量。 其结果突出了我们模型的互补优势,这些优势被“互动科学”的两个镜头所抓住。 PFT衡量一个模型是否能够正确执行长期实施计划中指定的交互组件,而VQT则更强调整合视觉理解,可执行代码,以及科学推理. 在这种背景下,我们的模式表现尤其突出。 Prisma 编码器 - 9B 和 Prisma 编码器 -35B既能取得比其他开放型号高得多的VQT分数,又能保持有竞争力的PFT性能. 这个缺口很重要,因为单靠产生战术上有效的前端代码是无法在VQT上取得成功的. 生成的科学演示还必须反映任务中被编码的预期视觉状态和科学关系. 因此,结果指出了我们模型的有用属性,其能力不限于实施孤立的UI相互作用,而是在遵循详细的实施计划时扩大到协调代码、视觉要求和科学内容。
